gallery: White It's Better To Be Lucky patch hat, front
buyBody: The brand line on a woven patch, front and center, on white. It is the most direct thing we make — no logo to decode, just the sentence the whole company is named after.
pieceHeadline: The one that says it out loud
pieceParas: Most golf hats make you work out who made them. This one just tells you what we think, which is that skill matters and so does luck, and pretending otherwise has never made anyone a better player.
White with the patch stitched on the front panel. It goes with everything in the range because white goes with everything, and it is the hat people ask about most.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body. Golfer walking off a green, brim low, patch catching the light. Shot from slightly below and to the side so the front panel reads flat and the stitching is legible. There is no on-body hat photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
